items.text: AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO LOCAL GOVERNMENT
COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES

items.actClause:
AN ACT to incorporate the Croton Falls Volunteer Fire Department Benevolent
Association, and providing for its powers and duties
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S8810

SPONSOR: HARCKHAM
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to incorporate the Croton Falls Volunteer Fire Department Benevo-
lent Association, and providing for its powers and duties

 
PURPOSE:

Incorporates the Croton Falls Volunteer Fire Department Benevolent Asso-
ciation, and provides for its powers and duties

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 creates the "Croton Falls Volunteer Fire Department Benevolent
Association".

(2) Provides those who are eligible for membership in the "Croton Falls
Volunteer Fire Department Benevolent Association". Those individuals are
all persons who are now, or have been, or will be active volunteer
members of the Croton Falls Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. in the coun-
ty of Westchester, and who have acquired or will acquire the status of
exempt volunteer firefighter as defined in section 200 of the general
municipal law by virtue of having rendered service in the Croton Falls
Volunteer Fire Department, Inc., and all persons who are now or will be
active volunteer members of the Croton Falls Volunteer Fire Department,
Inc., shall be eligible for membership, except those who have been
removed for cause, expelled, or dropped from the Croton Falls Volunteer
Fire Department, Inc., and who have not been reinstated.

(3) expands the purposes of the association to include: providing relief
to disabled members, safeguarding the welfare of members, promoting the
health and safety of members, enhancing the morale of members by provid-
ing social and recreational activities, and promoting the volunteer fire
service.

(4) states the powers and duties of the "Croton Falls Volunteer Fire
Department Benevolent Association", which include all the powers of a
not-for-profit corporation. Accordingly, the provisions of law relating
to not-for-profit corporations shall apply to the Association, except
where they conflict with the provisions of this act.

(5) provides the initial organizational meeting of the "Croton Falls
Volunteer Fire Department Benevolent Association", which shall take
place no later than sixty days after this act takes effect.

(6) provides the control and disposal of funds and property of the
"Croton Falls Volunteer Fire Department Benevolent Association". The
control and disposal of the funds and property of the such Association,
the exercise of its powers, and the management and control of its
affairs shall be vested in and exercised by a board of trustees, which
shall include a president, a vice-president, a secretary, and a treasur-
er, and three other members having the title of trustee.

(7) Provides the precept for payment of foreign fire insurance premium
taxes in relation to the association.

Section 2 is the effective date.
 
JUSTIFICATION:

New York's volunteer fire departments are struggling to recruit and
retain members at an alarming rate. Keeping a capable and enthusiastic
volunteer force is essential to the safety of New Yorkers.

The bill seeks establishment of the "Croton Falls Volunteer Fire Depart-
ment Benevolent Association". Croton Falls Volunteer Fire Department is
located in Westchester County.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

This is a new bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None to the State.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately; provided, however, that the
provisions of section (7) of this act shall apply to taxes due on premi-
ums received on and after January 1, 2023.
